name: starter
description: Safe mock_demo actions for first-agent onboarding: echo, simulated failure, and approval gate.

actions.name: demo.echo
actions.description: Echo input through mock_demo — proves the happy path without external APIs.
actions.idempotency_guidance: Use a stable key per logical echo; retries with the same key return the same run.

actions.name: demo.fail_once
actions.description: Simulates a failed first attempt for recovery visibility; retry with input.retry=true or a new idempotency key.
actions.idempotency_guidance: First attempt fails by design. Retry with a new idempotency key and input.retry=true to complete.

actions.name: demo.needs_approval
actions.description: Pauses at approval_required — proves human-gated policy before execution.
actions.idempotency_guidance: Use one key per approval request; do not reuse keys across distinct approval decisions.
